retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually transcribed selected zero-based source rows; generated normalized facts
immutable_content_note: Immutable raw content was unavailable; retrieved master rows are not asserted byte-identical to the history-head revision.
limitations: Dedicated catalog membership retains REFLECT_ANY; the card is not ordinary zero-defense armor.
The source has no DFS kind or ordinary defense value, no attack kind or boost, no percentage, other harm, disease, MP cost or retained miracle.
The empty attribute is neutral and participates in defense element composition.
The post-reaction exemption depends on the first defense piece, not the position of the reflection artifact alone.
ID196 first reflects and stops consumption before any later submitted pieces. Prefix pieces before it are consumed and their status effects remain.

For a non-MAGIC item with an earlier prefix, Dark attacks and COUNTER origins are rejected and final attribute compatibility is required. ID195 can clear a weapon attribute but cannot remove COUNTER origin.
Successful reflection swaps current source/target and returns the original current attack payload; previous ordinary defense reductions are discarded.
Payload amount, element, chance, status extras, originating artifact ID and retention provenance remain; an already-hit percentage attack is not rerolled.
For a reflected money counter, credit follows its current redirected source, independently of its immutable original artifact owner.
The card cannot start an ordinary attack or add ATK; it can be discarded.
The effect only applies when a response exists; initial self spells and automatically resolved self-MP counters do not expose a reflection choice.
The old server branch ends on finalized-dead target but does not independently reject finalized-dead source.
Exact historical XML traces and current official-client fidelity are not asserted; Fog and Illusion remain excluded.
Historical IDs and technical labels are not verified current official IDs or names.
Old acquisition weights are not verified official probabilities; upstream reports distribution uncertainty.
All sixteen earlier catalogs, fingerprints and miracle indices remain unchanged.
target: Incoming items that actually offer a response, regardless of WEAPON, MAGIC or COUNTER origin; immediate self effects do not offer reflection.

prefix_gate.first_defense_piece_196: Skip final Dark, counter and ordinary element checks.
prefix_gate.magic_origin: Skip final checks regardless of earlier defense prefix.
prefix_gate.other_prefix_nonmagic: Require non-Dark attack attribute, non-COUNTER originating item and compatible final composed defense attribute.
